# cognoscene

> cognoscene is a Chrome extension that helps people pause impulse purchases before checkout.

## Product

- [Founding waitlist](https://cognoscene.com/waitlist): product overview and waitlist signup.
- [Privacy policy](https://cognoscene.com/privacy.html): how cognoscene handles personal data.
- [Terms of use](https://cognoscene.com/terms.html): service terms.

## Core behaviour

- Cognoscene introduces designed friction before checkout.
- A 48-hour decision hold helps users distinguish an impulse from an intentional purchase.
- The product dashboard tracks purchases rationalised over time.
